prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Miami. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need one quick detail first: what part of Miami are you in (zip code or neighborhood), and are you looking for treatment for an adult, teen, or child? Also tell me if cost/insurance, speed, or near-invisible treatment (Invisalign) is your top priority. With that I’ll give 4–6 specific orthodontists/clinics to call and why each is a good fit.

While you reply, here’s how I’ll choose and what you can use to vet options immediately

What I’ll look for when picking specific doctors
- Board-certified orthodontists (American Board of Orthodontics) when available.  
- Invisalign provider status (Gold/Platinum/Diamond levels indicate volume/experience).  
- Years of specialty training and local reputation (Google/Yelp/Healthgrades patient ratings).  
- Modern digital tech (iTero or other intraoral scanner, 3D imaging) — fewer impressions, better planning.  
- Clear before/after records and examples of cases like yours (adult crowding, bite correction, etc.).  
- Transparent pricing, financing options, and whether they offer free or low-cost consults.  
- Language needs (Spanish bilingual practices are common in Miami).

Quick resources you can use now
- Invisalign Doctor Locator (to find certified providers near you).  
- American Association of Orthodontists “Find an Orthodontist” tool.  
- Google Maps / Yelp for patient reviews and photos.  
- Florida Dept. of Health license lookup for provider credentials.

What to ask when you call (or at the consult)
- Are you a specialist (orthodontist) or a general dentist doing orthodontics? (Prefer an orthodontic specialist.)  
- How many Invisalign cases do you treat per year, and what level of Invisalign provider are you?  
- Do you use digital scans (no messy impressions)? Can you show before/after photos of cases like mine?  
- Estimated treatment length, total cost, what’s included (retainers, adjustments), and available payment plans/insurance acceptance.  
- Do you offer a free/discounted consultation and initial records (x‑rays/scans)?

If you tell me your neighborhood or zip code now I’ll list 4–6 specific Miami orthodontists to call, with short reasons for each (experience, Invisalign expertise, patient ratings, languages, and fit for adults/teens).
